spec: Placing a template's motif (walldye/tools/motif.py, src/lib/motif.ts). The motif is the root's last child, opening with exactly <g data-motif="" transform="...">. transform: translate(x y) with x and y to 2 decimals, then scale(k) to 4 decimals unless k is 1, trailing zeros dropped. place: the motif's transform replaced. ground: the template without its motif. alone: the root showing box (motif-local units), the template's defs line, and the motif group untransformed. placements: ok says whether a visitor could make the placement on that canvas (anchor on the canvas, size within scale, cell * size whole to 0.001); clamped is the nearest one the site offers (anchor rounded to whole units and clamped; size clamped, then to whole cells (cell * size rounded half up, kept within scale) at 4 decimals, or to 2 decimals without a cell).
